programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi embarks on a sweet treat adventure! He visits a chocolate shop to learn how delectable sweets are made, becoming a confectioner for the day. Then his culinary journey continues at a local bakery where he visits the kitchen to learn how to bake a variety of tasty goods, all while learning about healthy eating.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi, Meekah and Ms. Rachel for a big day of creative adventures! The fun begins as they explore the sounds of the city, make a song with instruments and hop on a train. Then Blippi visits the winner of his classroom contest for more learning through play, including a fun game of Freeze Dance, drawing and messy sensory fun with shaving cream!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some tricky problems! Newt discovers an abandoned bird egg and hopes to hatch it, but she is distressed to discover that Fuse is tasked with chopping down the tree it's in! Then, a snowy day gives Pogo the perfect chance for new pranks, but he goes too far and is sent to a boot camp to learn discipline. Plus, Newt struggles with building a flatpack treehouse and gets some unwanted 'help' from Fuse.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some tricky situations! First, Slick receives a knitted hat from Newt that he hates, so he comes up with a plan to 'accidentally' lose it so he doesn't hurt her feelings. Then, Fuse's terrible temper while watching sports gets him in trouble, and he has to try his best to keep a lid on it while watching a game with Newt. The trouble continues when Jeff gets a mysterious itch and blames it on a sleeping Zee!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! After helping the crew figure out what they're looking for (popsicles!), Blippi and Meekah join them on some creative adventures. They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange night for the Oddbods! Slick fancies himself a great dancer, but he's terrible! When he discovers the truth, Jeff is kind enough to offer his services and soon transforms him into quite the mover. Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he investigates some BIIIG vehicles! First, he heads to a construction site to learn all about bulldozers! After learning how bulldozers work and even getting to bulldoze some things himself, Blippi teaches us the fun Bulldozer Dance! Then, Blippi visits a farm where he gets to learn all about another big vehicle, a tractor swather. He finds out how it's used to cut grass in big fields and even gets to ride around and try it out for himself!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for some vroom vroom working vehicles! Blippi wants to build a playground, but his toy bulldozer is too small. He learns that there are giant construction vehicles that can get the job done. Then, Firefighter Blippi visits a fire station to learn all about firetrucks and how they help the community.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day at Jumper Jungle indoor playground! On a day of sporty play, Meekah finds different sports balls, including a basketball and a soccer ball. As she collects them, she searches for the best place to play each sports game. Then, it's a day of bouncy play! Join Meekah as she bounces around the inflatable play structures and bounces like a bunny, frolics like a frog and hops like a hare!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo in a series of adventures where everything goes wrong! First, Joey plans the perfect birthday party for Boo, only to forget her present at the last minute! Then, when Boo gets sick, Joey must go on an arduous journey for soup ingredients. The bad luck continues as Joey gets stuck to the back of a spider, they get encased in cement while chasing a berry and they are accidentally rolled up inside a meatball by a dung beetle!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The T-Rex Ranch is embarking on a colossal quest to move to a new home in California! The first leg of the journey proves to be an incredible challenge, but the difficulty skyrockets when a surprise dinosaur stampede breaks out. The entire team must spring into action to handle the dino-sized roadblock, round up the herd, and get their massive adventure back on track.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The great dino-move to California continues, but the convoy is hit by a series of mysterious equipment malfunctions that bring their progress to a halt. Stranded on the side of the road, the ranchers must become master mechanics, working together to diagnose and fix their vehicles. It's a race against time to solve the strange breakdowns and get their precious prehistoric cargo back on the road to their new home.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The move to California continues as the Park Rangers get the new T-Rex Ranch ready for the dinosaurs! First, Park Ranger Aaron meets the new Park Ranger, Tara, who quickly joins in to help him with some messy dino doody duty. Then, with the help of another new ranger, Sophie, Aaron builds strong paddock fences around the new ranch to keep all the dinosaurs safe. But their task takes a turn when a raptor arrives, frantically searching for her missing baby egg!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a land, sea and space extravaganza! First, she boards the Intrepid aircraft carrier for an air and sea adventure! programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are in for some big surprises! Newt discovers a treasure map that leads to a valuable find, but it's buried under Jeff's pristine lawn! A battle of wits begins! Then, Jeff's prize marrow comes to life thanks to some radioactive waste! Finally, after a night of gorging on Bubbles' vegetable patch, Zee wakes up to discover that he's grown into a giant overnight! Trapped inside his house, the others must work to find an antidote.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange night for the Oddbods! Slick fancies himself a great dancer, but he's terrible! When he discovers the truth, Jeff is kind enough to offer his services and soon transforms him into quite the mover. Then, Fuse's perfect night's sleep is interrupted by an intruder: a very resilient and resourceful mouse! Who will triumph in this battle of wills? Finally, Slick and Newt go on a date, but things don't go as planned when Newt is infected by a werewolf!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. Then, after a near-accident, Bubbles creates a health serum to improve a cow's intelligence, but a guinea pig eats it instead and develops a super-brain! Finally, it's photo day, and Slick is determined to make sure he's front and center in the picture this year.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some tricky problems! programme.title: Meekah

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for some technological mayhem with the Oddbods! What's more annoying than Pogo? Another Pogo! Then, he uses an invisibility device to cause all sorts of havoc in Oddsville, making his neighbors think they're being haunted by ghosts! Plus, Slick orders a robot buddy, but it malfunctions and causes trouble.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Then, Fuse and Slick are smitten with a female jogger who blows them both a kiss. The pair are determined to outshine one another to prove who the kiss was for. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! After being caught in one of Bubbles' experiments, Fuse and Newt accidentally switch bodies! As Bubbles searches for a way to reverse it, an over-excitable Fuse enters the now curmudgeonly Newt into a dance competition. Then, Slick goes on an increasingly desperate quest to find a 'Golden Ticket' for an exclusive disco-party. Plus, Slick is determined to look his best for the group photo.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi and Meekah on some amazing construction adventures! First, they visit the Magic House to meet a special friend. Together, they build a huge mountain out of rocks and create one of the tallest towers in the world! Then, Blippi explores Dig It, a playground that's all about construction! He learns about real excavators and front loaders, builds a tower out of bricks and races different construction vehicles around the site.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Do you ever wonder about all the animals on our planet? So does Blippi! Join him as he heads to the world-famous San Diego Zoo to discover something new. In one of the biggest zoos in the world, there is so much to see and learn. From beautiful, colorful macaws to amazing camouflaging bugs, Blippi learns all about the unique animals we share our planet with.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she learns to care for cute animals! First, she visits a pet adoption center where she meets some very adorable animals! She plays with puppies and kittens and learns all about adopting and taking care of a new pet. Then, Cowgirl Meekah is taking care of the town! She gets to be the animal caretaker for the day, feeding and brushing the horses. Plus, she visits a farm to pick berries to make some yummy lemonade!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she explores the amazing Kennedy Space Center! Her adventure begins as she learns about rockets, space shuttles and the scientific discovery of space. She gets to see the famous spacecraft Atlantis and sit in a model of a flight deck! Then, it's time to blast off as Meekah goes on her very own virtual Mars Mission! She learns about the international space station, does a space walk and goes on a simulated trip to Mars!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi becomes a basketball pro with help from some amazing friends! He learns tips, tricks and the importance of practice and coordination from WNBA pro, Tamika Catchings. Then he teams up with NBA player Andre Drummond, where they agree to trade skills-Andre teaches Blippi basketball and Blippi teaches Andre how to be more like Blippi!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi has so many buddies that he loves! There's Meekah, and TABBS, and DBO and all of the friends he meets on his adventures. Blippi invites his buddies at home to join him in remembering some of his favorite moments spent with friends. Awwww!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Racecars, firetrucks, construction vehicles... oh my! Blippi loves learning about vehicles of all shapes and sizes, so he's excited to share his top ten moments in a vehicle! From go-karts to rocketships, and even a Monster Jam truck, these are his favorite vehicle adventures!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite ANIMAL episodes! He meets new animal friends like cheetahs, reindeer, and even sting rays and gets to play and feed some of them, too! Count down with him to number 1!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! After being caught in one of Bubbles' experiments, Fuse and Newt accidentally switch bodies! As Bubbles searches for a way to reverse it, an over-excitable Fuse enters the now curmudgeonly Newt into a dance competition. Then, Slick goes on an increasingly desperate quest to find a 'Golden Ticket' for an exclusive disco-party. Plus, Slick is determined to look his best for the group photo.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new obsessions! Jeff is convinced that Pogo is responsible for the theft of a bale of straw from his garden, but no one believes him. Jeff begins an obsessive quest to clear his name and prove that Pogo is behind it all! Then, feeling emasculated, Jeff seeks Fuse's help to teach him to be stronger and more macho. But it's not long before his new macho-ness becomes a problem.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big changes! Pogo tries his new hypnosis machine on Jeff, who scoffs at it. But it's not long before Pogo gets Jeff to behave like a dog! Then, Zee and Jeff are forced to live together when Jeff calls fumigators on Zee's house. How long can this alliance of opposites last? Plus, when Newt goes on holiday, Zee is enlisted to house-sit and look after her beloved pet hamster!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some magical situations! Pogo is bored, so when he discovers a genie in a magic lamp who grants three wishes, he uses them to try and get his friends in the mood for fun. Then, Jeff wants to impress his friends with his hors d'oeuvres, but he is upstaged by Zee, who has a secret ingredient. Finally, Zee accidentally gets on Bubbles' rescue mission to stop a meteor storm and his surprising talent may be just what she needs!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Explore amazing vehicles this Vehicle Month! Help Blippi and Meekah fix the BlippiMobile. See mail delivery, fly a space rocket, visit a construction site, learn about firetrucks, and race a fast Formula 1 car!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is ready to make a splash! He has fun at Aquatica Park, learning water safety from a lifeguard and trying out amazing water slides including a rainbow one. He continues his day of water play at Yas Waterworld, experiencing fast slides and splishing and splashing through the park. Blippi also makes new animal friends at NatureWorks as part of his day of discovery!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: How does a recycling truck work? What happens on a farm? Will this object Sink or Float? Blippi explores the world around us with silly dance moves, fun songs, and awesome adventures. There is so much to learn about, it will make you want to shout 'BLIPPI'!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for Vehicle Month and discover amazing trucks! Learn about monster trucks with Megan, see why flies love garbage trucks, explore an ice cream truck with Sherry Pop, and see how Kareem the Crane builds a skyscraper.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a tough time! Slick decides he needs to get fit and foolishly accepts Fuse's offer of a 'Boot Camp.' But when it turns out to be too much hard work, Slick decides he's had enough! Then, Newt has an accident with some paint flecks and is misdiagnosed with an infectious tropical illness, forcing her into quarantine. Finally, Pogo and Jeff get into a battle over who can sell the best ice creams, which escalates to destructive levels.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing new challenges! Pogo is shunned by everyone after his latest prank backfires, so he ventures to prove that he's a changed Bod. Then, Slick enlists Bubbles as his dance partner for an upcoming competition but is horrified to realize that she's the worst dancer ever! How will he get out of this commitment? Finally, Slick recruits Newt to be his assistant for his latest ambition: to be a great magician!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The T-Rex Ranch is embarking on a colossal quest to move to a new home in California! The first leg of the journey proves to be an incredible challenge, but the difficulty skyrockets when a surprise dinosaur stampede breaks out. The entire team must spring into action to handle the dino-sized roadblock, round up the herd, and get their massive adventure back on track.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The great dino-move to California continues, but the convoy is hit by a series of mysterious equipment malfunctions that bring their progress to a halt. Stranded on the side of the road, the ranchers must become master mechanics, working together to diagnose and fix their vehicles. It's a race against time to solve the strange breakdowns and get their precious prehistoric cargo back on the road to their new home.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The move to California continues as the Park Rangers get the new T-Rex Ranch ready for the dinosaurs! First, Park Ranger Aaron meets the new Park Ranger, Tara, who quickly joins in to help him with some messy dino doody duty. Then, with the help of another new ranger, Sophie, Aaron builds strong paddock fences around the new ranch to keep all the dinosaurs safe. But their task takes a turn when a raptor arrives, frantically searching for her missing baby egg!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Spring has sprung, and so have the Antiks! Join them as they explore a world of blossoming flowers and fresh spring treats. From climbing giant mushrooms to navigating through a garden of delights, their adventures are as colorful as the season. It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi and Meekah are feeling the need for speed! They visit the famous Daytona International Speedway to find out what makes NASCAR race cars go so fast. They meet a real NASCAR driver, learn all about the amazing cars and even get to try out a fun race car simulator! They also explore some of the cool jobs at the racetrack, learning what it's like to be a spotter, a crew member and a race car driver.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a day of prehistoric and geological wonders! The adventure starts with a visit to the active Kilauea volcano in Hawaii where Blippi explores plant and animal life around a crater with a local tour guide. Then he travels back in time at the Orlando Science Center where he learns about fossils, growls like a dinosaur and meets a giant T-Rex and a Triceratops with three enormous horns.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Meekah is having a magical day at Children's Fairyland! She learns about colors, shapes and numbers as she goes down colorful slides, rides the Jolly Trolly train around the park, plays with bubbles and rides a merry-go-round! Then, while exploring, Meekah discovers a magic key which unlocks a Storybook Box! The box sets her on a journey to use all her five senses to find a yummy treat!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Where is Blippi today? Join Blippi as he visits the Funtastic Playtorium at Tacoma Mall, WA. Blippi explores the indoor play place for kids while learning core education for children such as Colors, Numbers and more! Blippi visits an indoor playhouse. Come along with Blippi as he climbs, jumps and slides his way into learning the importance of exercise.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi, Meekah and their friend Emily for a day of building and science! The adventure begins as they work together to build a great big fort in the living room using household items and mega blocks. Afterwards they team up with aerospace engineer Emily Calandrelli for some fizzy fun, doing cool science experiments with baking soda, vinegar and oobleck!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite ANIMAL episodes! He meets new animal friends like cheetahs, reindeer, and even sting rays and gets to play and feed some of them, too! Count down with him to number 1!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: 3-2-1, Blast off!! Blippi is curious and loves to learn about the world around him so he's excited to share his top ten favorite space and science moments with his friends!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about his love for construction adventures. Countdown with him to number 1!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! After helping the crew figure out what they're looking for (popsicles!), Blippi and Meekah join them on some creative adventures. They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for Vehicle Month and discover amazing trucks! Learn about monster trucks with Megan, see why flies love garbage trucks, explore an ice cream truck with Sherry Pop, and see how Kareem the Crane builds a skyscraper.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! Fuse fires up the BBQ, but an uninvited guest arrives: a teeny-tiny house spider! Fuse tries to play it cool and goes to extreme lengths to avoid it. Then, Slick's dad shows up out of the blue, so he pretends that Jeff's house is his and that Jeff is his butler! How long can they keep up the secret? Finally, Pogo and Bubbles get stranded in the desert!

programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Perkahwinan Dari ...
programme.desc: Pasangan selebriti terkenal di Malaysia, Asha dan Mal terdesak untuk menjaga rahsia perkahwinan mereka dari diketahui oleh pengurus mereka, Feek.

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Geng
programme.desc: Isabella is an ex-convict who has sworn off her life of crime. Unfortunately, her old gang boss wants her to do one last drug transaction and kidnaps her mother to blackmail Isabella. With the help of her high school best friends, Mariam and Anita, Isabella goes on a road trip to save her mother.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...
programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah

programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Mat So'od
programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Perkahwinan Dari ...
programme.desc: Pasangan selebriti terkenal di Malaysia, Asha dan Mal terdesak untuk menjaga rahsia perkahwinan mereka dari diketahui oleh pengurus mereka, Feek.

programme.title: Roti Canai Love Story
programme.desc: Kisah hubungan persahabatan di antara kanak-kanak berbangsa Melayu dan Cina yang bermula dari kisah sekeping roti canai dan konflik keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Anais Patah Hati Pertama Kali
programme.desc: Anais is a pastry chef in her thirties that is having a heartbreak for the first time in her life and having difficulties controlling her emotions.

programme.title: Mark Masuk Jawi
programme.desc: A comedy featuring Mark,an English man who has been married to Suraya. He is forced to confront his anxieties when his father-in-law directs him to undergo traditional circumcision as promised by his wife.

programme.title: Abang Tinted & Handbag Ajaib
programme.desc: Kisah seorang lelaki yang kehilangan segalanya selepas ditipu rakan niaganya, tapi diselamatkan oleh tas tangan ‘ajaib’ yang mempunyai jalan penyelesaian kepada semua masalah.

programme.title: Mat So'od
programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Perkahwinan Dari ...
programme.desc: Pasangan selebriti terkenal di Malaysia, Asha dan Mal terdesak untuk menjaga rahsia perkahwinan mereka dari diketahui oleh pengurus mereka, Feek.

programme.title: Girlfriend Aku Dari Neraka
programme.desc: Kisah Rudi yang telah menjalinkan hubungan kekasih bersama Tasha, atau lebih dikenali sebagai "Girlfriend Dari Neraka". Lakonan Aiman Hakim Ridza, Sharifah Sakinah dan Ayda Jebat.

programme.title: Bawang Putih Bawang Holland
programme.desc: Pak Mat is trying to find husbands for his two daughters fearing they would be old spinsters, he runs an audition causing further chaos.

programme.title: Cupcake Mama
programme.desc: Hanna, an active woman, is becoming bored with her daily life. She soon gets the idea to start a business selling cupcakes.

programme.title: Bila Kau Datang
programme.desc: The sudden presence of a little girl in a man's life raises thousands of questions, yet it also blossoms into a pretty special relationship.

programme.title: Kampung Arena Panggang
programme.desc: Di dalam sebuah kampung, pasti terdapat perebutan kuasa. Siapakah yang bakal memegang jawatan tertinggi? Saksikan gelagat lucu mereka berentap untuk digelar ketua kampung.

programme.title: Nyanyuk
programme.desc: Zali is sad with the condition of his wife, Minah who he thinks is senile when in fact he is the one facing the disease.

programme.title: Jongkong
programme.desc: Wan Ibrahim perlu mencari penyelesaian segera untuk melarikan diri daripada pakciknya, Wan Usin, dengan menjual beberapa jongkong emas yang dirompak oleh mereka, dan dia perlu melalui pelbagai cabaran.

programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Resipi
programme.desc: Radiah pindah semula ke rumah ibubapanya demi untuk menjaga ayahnya lalu mula memasak mengikut resipi arwah ibunya, dalam usahanya Radiah mula mempelajari tentang dirinya dan juga tentang ibu dan ayahnya.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Hello Gold Coast
programme.desc: Nini dan Haikal pergi bercuti ke Gold Coast, Australia. Percutian mereka tidak berjalan seperti yang dirancang. Namun akhirnya ia menjadi satu pengembaraan yang hebat.

programme.title: Jejaka Terhangat Di Pasaran
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a handsome man, Azrul, who is a favorite of many women at his workplace. They do various things to win Azrul's heart.

programme.title: Luar Biasa
programme.desc: Kisah yang diinspirasikan daripada pemenang pingat emas Paralimpik, Mohamad Ridzuan yang menghadapi penyakit 'Cebral Palsy' dan abangnya yang sentiasa ada di sisinya.

programme.title: Sekolah Api
programme.desc: Api, gangster yang meningkat naik cuba memenuhi amanat arwah neneknya untuk menghabiskan SPM. Dia jatuh cinta dengan guru Bahasa Inggeris dan sanggup melakukan apa saja untuk memenangi hati guru tersebut.

programme.title: Balapan
programme.desc: Kisah empat orang remaja yang telah menjadi musuh sejak sekian lama di lapangan balapan acara pecut 100meter peringkat daerah Selangor dan akhirnya menjadi sahabat seperjuangan.

programme.title: Lampu Merah
programme.desc: Si lelaki sukakan si perempuan, tanpa sedar yang si perempuan itu psiko dan obses dengan cintanya. Cara untuk selamatkan diri hanya dengan jatuh cinta dengan si perempuan semula.

programme.title: Bini Aku Dari...
programme.desc: Lydia dan Rudy telah pun berkahwin. Lydia nak anak walaupun Rudy belum bersedia lagi. Perangai Lydia makin menjadi- jadi apabila mengikut hukum hakam dari kakiberamal.com.

programme.title: Tebus
programme.desc: Anak perempuan Mikail telah di culik dan untuk menyelamatkan anaknya dia cuba mengimbau kembali sejarah lampau dirinya ketika menyertai kumpulan gangster.

programme.title: Survival 486
programme.desc: Syuhada going hiking to Gunung Tahan with her friends. Unfortunately, she got lost and fell into a deep hole and trapped there for 19 days.

programme.title: Cik Paris Diva Kampung
programme.desc: Zulaikha merupakan seroang gadis bandar yang mencabar diri untuk hidup di kampung lalu terpikat dengan jejaka kampung yang berjaya menawan hatinya.

programme.title: Budak Dari Tak Bai
programme.desc: Melalui kehidupan yang getir, Johari meninggalkan Tak Bai pada zaman kanak-kanak ke Kota Bharu. Peristiwa hitam membuatkannya hanyut dalam dunia gelap. Dilakonkan oleh Kamal Adli dan Nabila Huda.

programme.title: Delen
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Delen yang mula rasa terancam apabila Emily mula menyukai pelajar baru bernama Robert. Sejak itu, bermulalah persaingan antara Delen dan Robert demi merebut cinta Emily.

programme.title: Bro Jenin
programme.desc: Kisah Jenin yang telah masuk ke zaman kini. Dia berjumpa dengan seorang animator, Emily. Wujud perbezaan pendapat maka terjadi lah kisah2 lucu dan akhirnya Jenin terpaksa pulang ke tempat asalnya.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Lamb Episode with Chef Craig Wong

programme.title: Game Episode with Chef Derek Dammann

programme.title: Popular Athens Recipes
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Greek Night
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: Canada + Greece
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: Hearty Greek Fare
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: Leaves and Lettuces
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.title: Psychic Witness: Killers in their Midst
programme.desc: The murder of an elderly couple shocks a small New York town. An Ohio family searches for a missing woman.Two psychics saw everything that happened. Noreen Renier senses the killer is lying about his alibi. Georgia Rudolph leads police to the body.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.desc: Get ready for a fun day of sports and play with JJ! He discovers the fun of putting on shoes and sliding at the playground. Then, sing 'Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes' while learning body parts! The active fun continues with a competitive soccer match against animal friends and a team sports day at the field. Plus, learn swimming skills on a hot day and go on an exciting ski trip with Ms. Appleberry and the class!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for sky-high and super fun adventures with JJ and his friends! First, Astronauts JJ and Mimi blast off into space, soaring past stars and planets before landing on the moon for a cheesy snack! When Boba loses his special balloon, the friends set off in a hot air balloon craft for a chase of a lifetime. The action continues as JJ and Wally train to be firefighters, but Wally's goofing around turns him into the one who needs saving!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Being little can be tough, but Baby John is growing up! First, he thinks he's ready to be big and make all his own decisions, but Mom and Dad help him understand that being little is pretty awesome, too! Then, Mom helps Baby John learn how to express all his different emotions and feelings, from grumpy to happy to proud. When Baby John loses his pacifier, the whole family joins in to help him on the big search!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns about all the things he can be when he grows up! His adventure starts with a school trip to the fire station, where the kids learn what to do in an emergency and how firefighters are true superheroes! Then, he learns about all the different community helpers, like police officers and doctors. The learning continues as he discovers all about traffic lights and road safety while playing with his new toy car.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns to do the right thing! When Buster accidentally breaks the class flower, he panics and tries to cover it up, but soon learns that telling the truth is always the best thing to do. Then, when he and Daddy spot a steam train speeding out of control, they know they have to do the right thing! They race after the train and save the day! From cleaning up his toys to helping a puppy, Buster is always trying to do the right thing.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he uses his brains to save the day! When he overloads the carwash with bubble mix, he gets trapped in a giant bubble and floats away! He has to use all his smarts to find a way back down. Then, when Amber the Ambulance crashes and can't move, there's a big emergency! Buster has to muster up his courage and become a 'Hero Ambulance Bus' to save his best friend Scout from a broken bridge.

programme.title: Morphle Classics
programme.desc: Unmask bandits disguised as long-lost relatives at a barbecue, learn hands-on farm animal care, play hide-and-seek with magic pets, race in powerful super suits, stop invisible ghost bandits, and calm a thunderous earth shark visit.

programme.title: Morphle Classics
programme.desc: Help a lost baby monster find its family while camping, become a real ninja to stop the Bandits, uncover a robot Mila conspiracy, round up missing zoo monkeys, learn what real firefighters do, and drive a broken-down bus around town.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house and needs to be stopped!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Celebrate Nature November as JJ paints on sunscreen at the beach, wrangles escaped farm animals, learns weather wear with Mom, rides his trike through wild landscapes, builds a backyard fort, and camps with family.

programme.title: Nina's Familia
programme.desc: Spend a fun-filled day with Nina and her amazing family! First, Nina and her siblings learn all about how things fly as they dream of soaring through the sky like their dad, who is a pilot! Then, it's time for a yummy adventure in the kitchen as Nina and her Abuelita (grandma) decide to make a traditional Mexican breakfast for everyone. The family fun continues as they go on a scavenger hunt for colorful flowers and work together to help the magical Star Star get back into the sky!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for sweet dreams and bedtime songs! Mummy helps Mia begin her nighttime routine by tucking her toys into cozy spaces. Then, they try out some super simple and calming animal-related yoga poses to help Mia have a restful sleep. Daddy also shows Mia that routines can be fun with his 'brush your teeth dance'! Finally, Mummy and Daddy play a beautiful lullaby on their guitars to help soothe the kids to sleep under the twinkling stars.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max and their friends! First, they head to the park for some rolling fun as they play Jack and Jill, rolling down the muddy grass and whizzing down the slide! Then, Max gets his first sippy cup and is so excited to show it off that he starts an impromptu tea party with all his playmates. The day of discovery ends with a rainy day competition to see who can make the biggest puddle splash of all!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a super creative day of play with Twinkle! First, it's time to get musical! Each toadstool makes a different musical note, allowing Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to create a musical tune. Then, get creative as Twinkle has fun painting a picture of what she sees. The fun continues as Twinkle shares a box full of super fun toys, and her friends learn how to play new musical instruments!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about colors, shapes and numbers with Twinkle! First, learn how to count with Twinkle as she finds five balloons in the colors red, blue, green, yellow and purple! Then, join Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to make sandcastles, learning different shapes like squares, triangles and circles. The learning continues as Twinkle and her friends build and count a beautiful tower of rainbow stones and discover the variety of shapes that clouds can take in the sky!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath and watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to learn about animals, numbers, ABCs and more! Join Kii and Yii as they head to Old MacDonald's farm to learn all the sounds the animals make. Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Come sing your favorite classic songs with Kii and Yii! The sing-along starts on Old MacDonald's farm, where the friends learn how to spell the friendly dog's name in the song 'Bingo'! Then, listen as Mr. Cat sings a story about his grand adventure visiting the Queen in her palace. The fun continues with the story of the Lion and the Unicorn, the flying adventure of 'Two Little Dicky Birds' and a song about the Old Woman Who Lived in a Shoe.

programme.title: The Speed record
programme.desc: MewMew has a new stopwatch and wants to time everything that everyone does, to get to them to do it at record speed. Life in Abra-Dabra becomes intolerable as everyone tries to be quicker than the next person. Eventually Deedee and the others persuade MewMew to break all his speed records. When he achieves it no one applauds him, so MewMew realises that many things are better done in their own sweet time. He also realises that by doing everything fast, he is missing out on enjoying many things.

programme.title: Doobydoo Meep Concert
programme.desc: The annual Doobydoo Meep concert is about to take place, and Charlie wants to practice one last time before heading out. So Deedee chips in by agreeing to follow specific instructions to organise the difficult to manage Doobydoos but also promises not to use magic for anything at all. Deedee mixes up the sandwiches for the Doodyboos with the recorders that she ends up sending off with Mewmew. Nino constantly keeps Deedee in check so that she doesn’t back out of her promise. Mewmew is having a tough time organising with the Doobydoos while Deedee finds out Charlie has slept of practising. The concert goes well, but they all decide they won’t have lullabies ever again.

programme.desc: Friendly and lovable mad scientist Granny Peters accidentally transforms her cute little pet hamster into a not-so-cute HUGE pet hamster and things get interesting when it escapes and decides to move into Gummy s place uninvited

programme.title: Robo-Gummy
programme.desc: Finding himself over-committed to too many things, Gummy orders a few duplicate robots of himself. who winds up in the end causing more trouble than they are worth

programme.title: Devan Ade
programme.desc: Uma must resist taking over Devans new enterprise of selling lemonade until he finally asks for help.

programme.title: Spice Is Right
programme.desc: Uma and Devan exchange recipes with their friends only to create a series of fusion dishes that everyone is nervous to taste.

programme.title: Confiscation Cabinets
programme.desc: When Friday is confiscated Fred breaks into a secure vault to rescue his best friend.

programme.title: The Mathematical Prince
programme.desc: Mr Fractals gifted nephew visits and Brains finds herself in a magical Cinderella style evening.

programme.title: Spaced Out
programme.desc: The Jungle's are sucked into the space by an alien species that loves cricket. They team up with the extra -terrestrials for a fantastic game and emerge victorious. A truly out-of-this-world tale.

programme.title: The Speed record
programme.desc: MewMew has a new stopwatch and wants to time everything that everyone does, to get to them to do it at record speed. Life in Abra-Dabra becomes intolerable as everyone tries to be quicker than the next person. Eventually Deedee and the others persuade MewMew to break all his speed records. When he achieves it no one applauds him, so MewMew realises that many things are better done in their own sweet time. He also realises that by doing everything fast, he is missing out on enjoying many things.

programme.title: Doobydoo Meep Concert
programme.desc: The annual Doobydoo Meep concert is about to take place, and Charlie wants to practice one last time before heading out. So Deedee chips in by agreeing to follow specific instructions to organise the difficult to manage Doobydoos but also promises not to use magic for anything at all. Deedee mixes up the sandwiches for the Doodyboos with the recorders that she ends up sending off with Mewmew. Nino constantly keeps Deedee in check so that she doesn’t back out of her promise. Mewmew is having a tough time organising with the Doobydoos while Deedee finds out Charlie has slept of practising. The concert goes well, but they all decide they won’t have lullabies ever again.

programme.title: Abc Song
programme.desc: Discover kindness, friendship, and love through songs that spread happiness everywhere.

programme.title: Police Duty Song
programme.desc: Ride ocean waves and enjoy a sunny seaside adventure filled with music and excitement.

programme.title: Five Little duck
programme.desc: Follow a little mouse racing around the clock in this classic nursery rhyme adventure.

programme.title: Skeleton Carols
programme.desc: Relax with soothing songs that create a peaceful and comforting rest time experience.

programme.title: Not Grown Up
programme.desc: Maple learns that carrying a comfort item is not babyish after visiting the Zooniverse.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Pancake tells a fib that grows into multiplying Fibasauruses causing growing chaos.

programme.title: Alone Together
programme.desc: Odessa wants alone time but keeps getting interrupted by the other Zoonicorns.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK

programme.title: SMK

programme.title: SMK

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.
