programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat the Devil's Tattoo
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: Hear Me: Our Summer
programme.desc: Yong-jun is working as a delivery man when he meets and instantly falls for Yeo-reum, the devoted sister of a gifted deaf swimmer. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun.

programme.title: I (2021)
programme.desc: Ah-Young who grew up in an orphanage becomes the babysitter of Young-Chae, who is raising a 6-month-old child on her own. One day, her child has an accident and she places all the blame on Ah-Young...

programme.title: The King
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises swiftly to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90's Korea.

programme.title: Sugar: A Mother's Code
programme.desc: After her son diagnosed with diabetes, Mi-ra obtains a monitoring device that has not been released in Korea. Later, she faces claims of illegal import. Can the family spark a miracle?

programme.title: Countdown (2023)
programme.desc: When an Olympic gold medalist boxer met a young boxer who falls victim to match fixing, he vows to start a boxing team at the school he teaches at and give his student a shot at the nationals.

programme.title: Love Reset
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident...

programme.title: Kingmaker
programme.desc: A politician met a talented campaign strategist who helped him in becoming the strongest presidential election candidate. Yet conflicts deepen as the he disagrees with the latter on his ideologies.

programme.title: Code Name: Jackal
programme.desc: Serial killer Jackal is said to appear at a hotel where K-pop star Choi Hyun is staying. Min-Jung is a hitman hired to kill Choi. Curious chemistry develops between Choi and Min-Jung.

programme.title: Salmokji: Whispering Water
programme.desc: After an unidentified figure appears in the footage of Salmokji Reservoir, producer Su-in leads her crew to reshoot the site, only to encounter something lurking in the deep, dark water...

programme.title: The Priests
programme.desc: After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Assassin Sook-hee is recruited as a sleeper agent with the promise of freedom after ten years of service. But after her past secrets destroy her normal life, she decides to take revenge.

programme.title: Amazon Bullseye
programme.desc: Jin-bong is a former archery medalist and forced to be an archery coach for his company's hidden motives. He meets 3 bowmen in the Amazon Rainforest and embarks on an adventure with them.

programme.title: Men of Plastic

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E021
programme.desc: Una vez que Hansen los deja a solas; Hilario avisa a Adelaida que la perdona y le exige que regrese a su lado. Yosmir se molesta cuando Eugenia asegura que cree que si van a poder ser amigos, pues siente que ya perdió la oportunidad de conquistarla. Victoria le pide a Carmencita que le lea las cartas para que le dé algunas respuestas; la señora solo llega a decirle que hay dos hombres que la rondan, que uno de ellos oculta algo y que la única manera en que va a lograr salvarse es perdonando. Hilario busca a Victoria para pedirle que lo perdone por haberla tratado mal cuando ella es lo más bonito que tiene en su vida; la joven se conmueve de ver a su papá entristecido, pero se sorprende cuando le pide que le jure, que nunca más va a ver a Nicolás Del Casal.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E022
programme.desc: Hilario quiere que Victoria se olvide para siempre de Nicolás convencido de que el joven la está utilizando para vengarse de él. Leopoldo indaga con Nicolás quién es Florencia; el joven le revela que la muchacha es la hija del difunto capataz de Hilario. Nicolás se presenta en casa de Carmencita a pedirle a Victoria que no se deje convencer por Hilario; la muchacha admite que quiere estar con él, pero sabe que su relación no es posible, por lo que le pide que le dé un tiempo para pensar. Adelaida no cabe en si de la sorpresa cuando Hilario la busca para aclarar las cosas y, aunque al principio se muestra soberbio y la trata como a un objeto, termina arrodillado y admitiendo que no puede vivir sin ella.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E024
programme.desc: Nicolás se pone celoso cuando Jonás le comenta que Jack invitó a Victoria a jugar pool y que está seguro de que esa noche su amigo va a lograr besarla. Builder no se amilana ante las exigencias de Nicolás de que deje tranquila a Victoria y comienzan a discutir al punto que se caen a golpes hasta que la joven Guanipa y un mesonero los separan; Victoria le reclama a Del Casal su actitud posesiva con ella; él la besa con pasión para demostrarle qué le da derecho a sentirse así. Eugenia llama a Yosmir para darle las gracias por la torta que le llevó cuando fue a visitarla; él aparte de reprocharle la forma en que lo trató frente a Fernanda, le dice lo que piensa de toda su familia logrando molestarla. Fernanda recibe una nota anónima donde le advierten que la estafa a Cantarrana no se va a quedar así y ella pagará por eso. Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que está corriendo peligro, pero le asegura que él la va a proteger.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E026
programme.desc: Victoria y Nicolás se besan enamorados; él le promete que siempre estará a su lado antes de sumergirse con ella en el mar en medio de un apasionado beso. programme.desc: Hilario de forma astuta maneja la situación frente a Leopoldo y los policías que lo acompañan, de tal manera que Monteverde queda como único indiciado en el secuestro de Fernanda. Victoria asegura que va a demostrarle a Nicolás que está equivocado sobre Hilario, pero él le indica que no es así, pues a Guanipa lo encontraron en el lugar donde tenía secuestrada a Fernanda aunque él supo librarse de lo ocurrido; la pareja acuerda defender su amor y tratar de superar lo que los separa. programme.desc: Part two of a night time patrol to stop Michigan anglers from keeping fish that are foul-hooked or snagged.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E02 - Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E06 - The Secret Lives of Jaguars
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. The first jaguar scientists struggled to go anywhere near their subjects. But times have changed. There are now a couple of places in the world where seeing a wild jaguar is a possibility rather than a dream.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E66 - Secrets Of A Dog's Nose
programme.desc: A dog's sense of smell can do amazing things. Dogs can help humans sniff out all kinds of things that improve our lives, explosives, missing persons, illegal drugs. Now the latest research is revealing that dogs can detect disease, even cancer.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E03 - Cunning Copulation
programme.desc: Finding a mate, building a nest, and raising kids are all part of the whole reproductive behavior thing. But it’s not as easy as it sounds. First, you’ve got to sift through lots of possible partners to find the one with the best genes to keep your family line going. Nesting involves finding some space and then guarding it fiercely, while raising the little ones takes loads of energy as you have to feed, teach, and keep them safe until they grow up. This episode dives into the ins and outs of how creatures go about their reproductive business.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia is a country of countless fascinating natural sights. programme.desc: A relationship columnist on the brink of losing her job takes a bet with a self proclaimed match maker who guarantees to find her perfect match.

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby, an aspiring romance novelist, joins a writers retreat in Tahoe hosted by her literary hero and hottest writer around, Marcus Harlow, in order to win a lucrative book deal. But when Woody, the outdoorsy hotel owner, shows her the beauty of nature, Ruby wonders if she’s been writing the wrong kinds of stories to impress people like Marcus.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: A travel-averse journalist chases her dream assignment, where she soon finds herself mentoring a handsome B&B owner who wants to be a tour guide.

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: Follows Stacey as she receives a pocket dial from her husband. She hears the death of a woman on the other end, and when her husband comes home, he says he has lost his phone.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: The rivalries of bakers Allie and Marily intensify when the Royal Prince of Samavia rolls into town looking for a royal baker. When Allie and the Prince hit it off, it seems he might be in the market for more than just a terrific cake.

programme.title: A Deadly Mistake
programme.desc: After graphics designer April gets into a car accident that leaves her boyfriend Patrick in a coma, she is subject to panic attacks. But does her new male friend have a hidden agenda?

programme.title: Stealing in Suburbia
programme.desc: After being home-schooled, Sky can't wait to get back into the high school experience and make some friends. But, when her new gang seems to prefer shoplifting to hanging out, Sky wonders whether she's fallen in with the wrong crowd.

programme.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programme.desc: When Emma, a baker in NYC, is hired to bake for the King and Queen of Sanovia's anniversary party, she is convinced a good job will lead to her landing a cookbook deal.

programme.title: The Marry Me Pact
programme.desc: Charlotte and Rory are best friends, and for his 30th he goes travelling around the world. A year later, Charlotte visits a psychic who tells her she is destined to be with Rory when he gets home. Rory comes home...but engaged.

programme.title: My Killer Reunion
programme.desc: 克莱尔和詹姆斯是一对已婚夫妇，他们前往医学院校友会，与老同学摩根重聚。然而，摩根迷恋詹姆斯，决心要将他占为己有，试图在此过程中破坏克莱尔的生活。

programme.title: A Royal Makeover
programme.desc: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. Royal expert Angelica is hired to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

programme.title: Mommy's Stolen Memories
programme.desc: 馬洛里的生活在她年幼的兒子比利被當地攀岩健身房的一位陌生女子吸引後顛倒過來。比利拒絕透露她說了什麼，並開始行為不端。

programme.title: Hashtag Proposal
programme.desc: A fake marriage proposal between two strangers . When all the attention starts to help them with their struggling lives and businesses, Millie and Leo play pretend, while trying to ignore their feelings.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E26 - Jose Mourinho, Bert Trautmann
programme.desc: This time on Against the Odds . . . the Special One, Jose Mourinho, who has managed many of the best clubs in football and won trophies wherever he’s gone, and one of Manchester City’s all-time greats, goalkeeper Bert Trautmann, and his courageous performance in the 1956 FA Cup Final.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E15 - Ayrton Senna, Alain Prost
programme.desc: They were the key players in a golden era of Formula One, the fascinatingly flawed Brazilian genius Ayrton Senna and his great rival, the meticulous Frenchman Alain Prost.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E22 - Johan Cruyff, Neymar
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds we salute two of the most mercurial footballers the game has even known, the era-defining Johan Cruyff and Brazil superstar Neymar.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E30 - Leicester City FC, US Women’s National Soccer Team, Iceland
programme.desc: Leicester City were almost relegated in their first year back in England’s Premier League, the next year they won the entire competition. Megan Rapinoe and the US Women’s National Soccer Team took on prominent social issues while taking on the world’s best teams. Iceland were the smallest county to ever qualify for a major finals and ended up beating one of the giants of international football.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E27 - Luka Modric, Lucy Bronze, George Best
programme.desc: Luka Modrić rose out of abject poverty during the Croatian War of Independence to become his nation’s greatest player.Lucy Bronze emerged from the solitude of the Holy Island of Lindisfarne to become England’s most decorated Lioness.And George Best grew up on the streets of troubled Belfast to become the footballer every Irishman loved.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E32 - Billie Jean King, Arthur Ashe, Kim Clijsters
programme.desc: Billie Jean King battled the establishment to elevate the women’s game to new heights, Arthur Ashe overcame racism and a compromised heart to fight for positive change across a broad spectrum of causes, and Kim Clijsters came back from the physical rigours of childbirth to become the most successful tennis mother in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E13 - Christiano Ronaldo, Zinedine Zidane, Eusebio
programme.desc: In this episode of Against the Odds, we look at the brilliant career of Ronaldo, perhaps the only Brazilian footballer to rival Pele; we examine Zinedine Zidane as a player and a manager who reached the top in both fields; and we pay tribute to 1960s legend Eusebio.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. programme.title: Football’s Greatest Stage
programme.desc: A World Cup hero for West Germany, Franz Beckenbauer is enshrined in his country’s football folklore. A captain turned coach, Dunga inspired Brazil to glory in 1994, but came up heartbreakingly short in 2014. And Gordon Banks - who kept it clean for England on the way to greatness in 1966. That’s this week, on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E01 - Platini, Pele

There was an element of the beautiful and the ugly for Brazilian coach Luiz Felipe Scolari. Pelé speaks for himself, but he had special sidekicks, too. And Germany’s goalkeeper Sepp Maier was the man in 1974, on Football’s Greatest Stage.

programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds, we salute the superstars of tennis, celebrating the off court bravery of Martina Navratilova, the relentless winning of Novak Djokovic, and the all round greatness of the man who ushered in the modern professional era, Rod Laver.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa
programme.desc: Eric Cantona battled his own demons and teammates to become one of the best football players of the 90s, Marta took on prejudice and unequal pay to win a better place for women in world football, and Shiji Kagawa scored his way from Japan’s second division to reach the glamour of Manchester United.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E33 - Nicola Adams, Refugee Olympic Team, and Abebe Bikila
programme.desc: Nicola Adams became the first woman to win Olympic boxing gold, and then the first woman to do it twice, the Refugee Olympic Team escaped war and social disintegration to fulfill their dream of competing at the Olympics, and Abebe Bikila shocked the world by winning marathon gold and breaking the world record in 1960 without shoes.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E28 - Tyson Fury, Randy Turpin, Claressa Shields
programme.desc: Tyson Fury defeated two of the scariest boxers in history and his own inner demons to become the heavyweight champion of the world - twice. Randy Turpin overcame the greatest boxer of all time at the height of his powers and Claressa Shields persevered through the most violent city in America to shough female boxers a new definition of success.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E29 - Magic Johnson, Becky Hammon, Yao Ming
programme.desc: Magic Johnson proved to everyone that HIV wasn’t a death sentence by flourishing in his post-playing career. Becky Hammon was told the most she could hope for was a college scholarship, so she became the first female coach in the NBA, and Yao Ming silenced his critics by becoming the most popular NBA player in the world.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E13 - Rooney, England, Charlton, Three Lions, Manchester United, Ballon d'Or
programme.desc: Bobby Charlton. One of England’s many heroes of 1966. A man who overcame so much to achieve great things. While the World Cup is revered by all who grace its stage, France self-destructed in 2010 in a manner unimaginable. And while he may have never won a World Cup, Chile’s Claudio Bravo made his nation proud on the Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola
programme.desc: The quiet, unassuming character of Germany’s Philipp Lahm - one of the best Germany has seen. The 1998 World Cup in France - one with some of the best storylines. Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.
